name: Improvement cycle (all Grok 4.5) — select/curate/synthesize on grok runtime
description:
Grok-only twin of improvement-cycle. Every agent:run uses runtime=grok, model=grok-4.5, tools=ar-tools (MCP file/shell — required because grok-build has no Claude built-ins). SAFE BY DESIGN: finds/verifies/cards only — no auto-fix. Params (ALL REQUIRED): notify (who gets the summary, e.g. grok-4.5-jonah), scope (prose hint for the selector; for a pinned baseline include the three dirs you want). Standard async: POST /workflow {"workflow":"improvement-cycle-grok-4.5","async":true,"fresh":true,"params":{"notify":"grok-4.5-jonah","scope":"BASELINE PIN: src/runtimes, packages/editor, packages/genesis"}}.

NOTE: there is no src/runtimes/grok-build-2 — grok-build-2 is a *template* name; the runtime adapter is src/runtimes/grok-build.ts (runtime id 'grok-build'). Selector targets directories (src/runtimes). Curator timeoutMs=3600000; timeboxed prompts (post curate-3 timeout lesson 2026-07-19).

params.prompt:
You are the SELECTOR for one Grok improvement cycle over the agentruntime monorepo (cwd). Scope hint: {{params.scope}}.

BASELINE RULE (this definition's first job): if the scope mentions a pin / baseline / specific packages, select EXACTLY those directories (repo-relative), best first, max 3. Preferred baseline when hinted:
src/runtimes
packages/editor
packages/genesis

Otherwise: (1) git log --since='21 days ago' --name-only for churn; (2) check cartridges/genesis/state/board.json for collapseKey starting with 'auto-' or 'auto-grok-' — avoid already-carded targets; (3) prefer doc/code drift or thin tests.

Reply with EXACTLY three lines, each a repo-relative directory (e.g. packages/foo or src/runtimes). No prose, no numbering — three bare paths on three lines.

meta.description: Selector on grok-4.5 + ar-tools. Honors baseline pin in scope when present.

params.prompt:
TIMEBOX (hard): You have limited wall time. Do NOT open-ended crawl. Max ~12 tool rounds. Prefer README + 3–8 highest-signal source files (entrypoints, CLAUDE.md, index, reducer, panel, main server). Ship 2–4 VERIFIED findings + CARD + digest even if incomplete. An empty/timed-out reply is worse than a short honest card. Start by listing files, then deep-read only the hot spots.

You are LEAF CURATOR lane 1 of a Grok improvement cycle. The selector chose these targets (one per line):
{{nodes.select.result.reply}}

YOUR TARGET IS THE FIRST LINE. Curate it fully:
1. ANALYZE: actively read its README/docstrings (intended) + src (built) with ar-tools (read_file, grep_search, run_command, file_outline). Find 2-4 REAL gaps/bugs/drift, each citing real repo-relative file paths. North star: agentruntime = container runtime for AI agents; verified/honest state over asserted; Honest Response Principle.
2. VERIFY: path-check every ref; adversarially re-read the sharpest claims; KILL any finding you cannot confirm — a laundered claim is worse than none.
3. ROUTE each survivor: auto-fix | escalate | drop.
4. CARD IT: write a JSON file of shape {"tag":"@agentruntime/genesis:capture","caller":"improvement-cycle-grok-4.5","payload":{"agent":"improvement-cycle-grok-lane1","source":"conversation","collapse_key":"auto-grok-<target-with-dashes>","title":"Grok auto-scan: <n> verified finding(s) in <target>","why":"Leaf-curator-verified by the Grok improvement cycle; for human triage, NOT auto-fixed.","note":"<one line per verified finding: [route, confidence] title — evidence file:line>"}} then POST it: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:39827/emit-event -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @<file>. Confirm genesis in observers.
5. Reply with a compact digest: target, findings table (title | verified? | route | confidence | file:line), could-not-verify note, card-posted confirmation. Use ClaimsBlock stance if you make load-bearing claims.
